From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & budget range validation

Hi Samir

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a couple of asks so we can prepare a proposal that fits your procurement process:

- Goals we heard: embed clinical summarization in the triage flow, endpoint ingestion for notes, target sub-200ms on short responses where possible.
- Expected traffic: you mentioned pilot traffic that could land around 5M tokens/month and a steady-state target between 10-15M tokens/month if clinical accuracy checks look good.
- Key procurement constraints: procurement owns PO thresholds and legal review triggers; if you can confirm the dollar thresholds that trigger legal review, that will help us size the commercial path.

Could you confirm 2 quick things:
1) Ballpark monthly budget range for the pilot and production (e.g., $/month band).
2) Any procurement thresholds (PO limit without legal review; contract size that needs SOC2 or additional security review).

Once I have those, I'll put together a short pricing worksheet (examples at $/1M tokens) and a procurement checklist to speed the next step.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm budget band + procurement thresholds (this thread)
- We send a tailored pricing worksheet + procurement checklist (by Mon)
- 30-minute follow-up to review pricing and contractual path (schedule link after you confirm)

Thanks
Marissa

From: Samir Shah <samir@orionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 13:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & budget range validation

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. Confirming the numbers you requested:

- Pilot budget: we have ~ $5k/month allocated for the pilot (expected ~5M tokens/month).
- Production band: if pilot metrics are good, we'll scale to 10-15M tokens/month with an expected monthly spend between $8k-$15k.
- Procurement thresholds: our procurement team can approve POs up to $10k without legal review. Anything over $25k requires legal and security review (SOC2 evidence is typically requested for >$25k).

On unit economics: we're targeting something in the neighborhood of $700-$1,200 per 1M tokens for evaluation (we understand pricing varies by model/latency tier). Can you provide an example that shows cost on a $/1M tokens basis plus a predictable monthly band for the ranges above? Also include any volume discounts or committed-capacity options.

Procurement contact is cc'd for formal checklist items. Decision timeline: we're aiming to select a vendor by mid-August assuming pilot outcomes are positive.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Product Lead, Clinical AI
Orion Health
samir@orionhealth.com

Can you:

Goal: have a polished worksheet and the procurement checklist ready to send to Samir on Monday so they can review ahead of a follow-up call.

Thanks

Hi Samir

Appreciate the quick clarity — that helps a lot. Attaching the pricing worksheet and a short procurement checklist for your team to review. Highlights below so procurement can triage quickly:

- Pricing examples (attached):
  - Standard latency model: $1,000 per 1M tokens (list), pilot credit available to keep initial month near $5k for 5M tokens.
  - Low-latency tier: $1,400 per 1M tokens (lower p95 latency, higher cost).
  - Committed capacity: 10% off list for 6-month commits; 18% off for 12-month commits (applies to steady-state volumes).

- For their stated bands:
  - 5M tokens (pilot): list ~ $5k/month (we can apply a $1k pilot credit to meet their $5k cap).
  - 10M tokens: ~$10k/month list (with 10% commit -> ~$9k).
  - 15M tokens: ~$15k/month list (with 10% commit -> ~$13.5k).

- Procurement summary:
  - PO approval up to $10k — good for pilot.
  - Anything >$25k needs legal/SOC2; we will prepare the SOC2 packet and a short security FAQ to reduce friction.

Next steps:
- I've uploaded the HubSpot deal (link below) and a DocuSign starter for a pilot SOW + PO-friendly terms: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 | https://docusign.com/placeholder-link/ORION-123
- Can we schedule a 30-minute pricing + procurement sync next week? I'll include Neha and our procurement checklist so we can close the pilot PO quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_PRICING_1M_tokens.xlsx, Procurement_Checklist_OrionHealth.pdf
